name: Xtile Chrome By Xenlism
description: 1x1 app launcher tile for Google Chrome - same Xtile widget as Xtile Firefox (shares its widget.js class via `extends XtileBaseWidget`), only the default .desktop in this widget's own config.json differs. Centered icon, app name at the bottom, card background auto-tinted from the app's own icon color.
author: Nattapong Pullkhow
